description:
Hello! We are students from Atyrau High School. We love hackhathon and design games. Our team is going to create story-driven Roblox game about space mission. 

Nowadays kids love playing games on different platforms and we want to use their interests. We also love play videogames and we decided to invent our idea. 

We are motivated,open to ideas and focused on fiishing something cool and playable.
